name: upgit
description: UPGit monorepo root. Vercel installs and bundles from this directory (api/index.js is the Function entrypoint, importing server/src/app.js), so every package server/src actually imports at runtime MUST be listed in "dependencies" below — Vercel does not read server/package.json. server/package.json is still the source of truth for VPS/Docker/Render/Netlify, which each run their own "npm install" inside server/; keep the two lists in sync when server/src's imports change (see server/package.json's own dependencies list).
